stack.backend: FastAPI + SQLite on Render (free web service)
stack.ai: Saaras v3 (speech-to-text, hi-IN), Sarvam-105B (misconception classification and re-teaching), Bulbul v3 (text-to-speech)

prototype_exit: On the public Vercel URL, a judge plays the sample Hindi clip (or records their own), sees the Saaras transcript and a named misconception within 10 s
The judge picks a re-teach modality (story, number line, real-life analogy) and the content renders, with a Bulbul 'Listen' button
The judge answers a spoken Bulbul drill, and the mastery graph for that skill changes and survives a page reload
If Sarvam fails or times out, the screen shows an error with a Retry button and the sample-clip path still works

risks.risk: Saaras plus 105B latency and JSON reliability on short child-style Hindi speech
Render free tier cold start (about 50 s) during the demo

steps.title: Deployed app shell
steps.goal: A judge opens the Vercel URL and sees a clean, branded Aawaz shell with the Speak, Re-teach, Drill and Mastery screens reachable, labelled 'sample data'.
steps.why_now: Gets a public URL up first so deploy problems surface at minute 5, not minute 28.
scope_in: Next.js + Tailwind app
4-screen navigation with a stepper
'Powered by Sarvam: Saaras, 105B, Bulbul' footer
Vercel deploy
tasks: npx create-next-app (TS, Tailwind, App Router)
Layout with one accent colour, large type, generous spacing
Stub the 4 screens with sample content and a visible 'sample data' badge
vercel --prod
acceptance: The public URL loads and all 4 screens are reachable by nav
Every stub shows a 'sample data' badge
At 390px width nothing scrolls horizontally
An unknown route shows a friendly 404, not a blank page
browser_check: Open <FRONTEND_URL>, click through the 4 screens, and take screenshot b01-screens.png of each
done_check: Open <FRONTEND_URL> and confirm all 4 screens render with the sample badge
The browser check passes and its screenshots are reviewed
steps.fallback: Deploy a static export if the Next.js build fails on Vercel.
steps.notes: UI: one accent colour, big Devanagari-friendly type (Noto Sans Devanagari), soft cards, no gradients overload. A taste/frontend-design skill is not installed; follow these rules by hand.

steps.title: Backend on Render, mastery persisted
steps.goal: The Mastery screen shows real per-skill scores read from the Render API's SQLite database, replacing the sample data.
steps.why_now: Proves the frontend-to-backend contract, CORS and env vars, and starts the Render cold start early.
scope_in: FastAPI with GET /health, GET /mastery/{student}, POST /mastery
SQLite table mastery(student, skill, score, updated_at)
CORS allowing the Vercel origin
Render deploy from render.yaml
Frontend NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
tasks: main.py with 3 routes
Seed 4 fraction skills at 0.3
render.yaml (python, uvicorn)
Wire the Mastery screen to fetch, with a 'waking up server' state
acceptance: The Mastery screen shows 4 skills with scores from the API, with no sample badge
While the API is cold, the screen shows 'waking up the server' rather than an empty chart
If the API is down, the screen shows an error with Retry, never zeros
A POST to /mastery changes the score returned by the next GET
tests: integration: POST then GET /mastery returns the updated score; an unknown student is created with defaults
browser_check: Block the API host and reload, then take screenshot b02-failed.png showing Retry
done_check: Open <FRONTEND_URL>/mastery and confirm the scores come from <BACKEND_URL>/mastery/demo
The browser check passes and its screenshots are reviewed
steps.fallback: If Render is slow to provision, keep localStorage mastery behind a flag.
steps.notes: Render free instances lose SQLite data on redeploy, so seed on startup. Add a keep-warm ping before the demo.

steps.title: Speak and get diagnosed
steps.goal: A student records (or plays the sample clip of) a spoken Hindi explanation and sees the Saaras transcript plus the named misconception, with the evidence phrase highlighted.
steps.why_now: This is the riskiest unknown and the winning feature: if Saaras plus 105B JSON classification is unreliable, we want the fallback with time left.
scope_in: Browser MediaRecorder with a Record/Stop UI
'Play sample' button using a Bulbul-generated Hindi clip saved to public/samples/
POST /diagnose (audio) calls Saaras v3 with hi-IN, then 105B with a fixed label list
Label set: M1 bigger denominator means bigger fraction, M2 add numerators and denominators, M3 whole-number thinking, M4 none
Transcript card plus a misconception card with a confidence chip
tasks: SARVAM_API_KEY in Render env
Generate the sample clip once with Bulbul: 'Mujhe lagta hai 1/3 bada hai 1/2 se kyunki 3 bada hai 2 se'
Classifier prompt returns JSON {misconception_id, skill, evidence, confidence}; parse with fallback to M4
Frontend states: recording, running, success, failed
acceptance: The sample clip returns transcript text and misconception M1 within 10 s
A silent or too-short recording shows 'we couldn't hear you, try again', never a diagnosis
If the 105B output is not valid JSON, the app shows 'unsure' with a Retry, not a made-up label
The API key never appears in frontend code or network responses
tests: unit: classifier JSON parser handles valid, fenced-in-markdown and garbage outputs
unit: unknown misconception ids map to M4
integration: POST /diagnose with the sample clip returns 200 and a transcript; with an empty file returns 422
browser_check: Open <FRONTEND_URL>/speak, click Play sample, and take screenshot b03-success.png of the diagnosis
Submit an empty recording and take screenshot b03-failed.png
Reload and confirm the page returns to the idle state: b03-reload.png
done_check: Open <FRONTEND_URL>/speak, click Play sample, and see the transcript and M1 within 10 s with no sample badge
The browser check passes and its screenshots are reviewed
steps.fallback: If the live mic or Saaras fails on stage, DIAGNOSE_MODE=fixture returns the recorded sample transcript and diagnosis.
steps.notes: Parameter names differ between SDK docs (language_code and target_language_code, saaras:v3). Check against the installed sarvamai version. Creative touch: highlight the exact spoken phrase that revealed the misconception.

steps.title: Re-teach in three modalities
steps.goal: After a diagnosis, the student picks Story, Number line or Real-life analogy and sees a Hindi re-teach for that misconception, which they can hear through Bulbul.
steps.why_now: Second half of the core loop (diagnose, then fix), and it shows off Bulbul.
scope_in: POST /reteach {misconception_id, modality} generates Hindi text with 105B, cached per pair in SQLite
POST /tts calls Bulbul and returns base64 audio
Number line is a React SVG component that plots the two fractions from the diagnosis
Tabs for the 3 modalities and a Listen button
Echo-back: Bulbul first repeats the student's reasoning kindly ('Tumne socha ki...')
tasks: Per-modality prompts (short, child-friendly Hindi, 4 sentences max)
Cache table reteach_cache
Audio player with loading and failed states
Number line component driven by two fractions from the diagnosis
acceptance: Each of the 3 modalities renders Hindi content for M1 within 8 s, and the second view is instant from cache
The number line shows 1/3 and 1/2 at the correct positions
If Bulbul fails, the text still shows and Listen shows 'audio unavailable, retry'
Content is never blank: a failed generation shows an error, not an empty card
tests: unit: the cache returns the stored text on the second call without calling the model
unit: number line position maths (a/b to x coordinate)
integration: POST /tts returns base64 audio that decodes to a non-empty WAV
browser_check: From the diagnosed state, click each tab and take screenshots b04-story.png, b04-numberline.png, b04-analogy.png
Force a Bulbul failure and take screenshot b04-audio-failed.png
done_check: Open <FRONTEND_URL>/speak, diagnose the sample, open all 3 tabs, and play Listen
The browser check passes and its screenshots are reviewed
steps.fallback: RETEACH_MODE=fixture serves hand-written Hindi text for M1, and audio is pre-generated.
steps.notes: Keep prompts under about 60 words to save tokens.

steps.title: Spoken drill and mastery update
steps.goal: The student hears a Bulbul-spoken drill, answers aloud, gets feedback, and sees the skill's mastery graph move on the Mastery screen.
steps.why_now: Closes the loop (diagnose, teach, practise, track) and delivers the prototype exit.
scope_in: POST /drill generates 3 targeted questions for the skill, with Bulbul audio each
POST /answer: Saaras transcribes, a simple check or 105B marks it, and the mastery score updates (+0.15 right, -0.05 wrong)
Mastery 'constellation' SVG: skills as nodes, brightness equals score, animating on change
Tap-to-answer fallback buttons for noisy rooms
tasks: Drill prompt returns JSON [{q_hi, answer}]
Answer check normalises Hindi numerals and fractions
Wire mastery POST to the existing B02 route
Mastery graph animation
acceptance: A correct spoken answer raises the targeted skill's score and the graph visibly updates
An unintelligible answer is not marked wrong: it shows 'say that again' and the score is unchanged
The mastery score survives a page reload, because it is read from the API
If drill generation fails, the screen shows an error with Retry and the mastery screen still loads
tests: unit: the answer normaliser maps 'ek tihai' and '1/3' to the same value
unit: the mastery update rule clamps to 0..1
integration: POST /answer with a correct clip raises mastery; with an empty file returns 422 and leaves mastery unchanged
browser_check: Run the full golden path on <FRONTEND_URL>: Play sample, diagnose, re-teach, drill, answer. Take screenshots b05-1..b05-5.png
Reload the Mastery screen and take b05-persisted.png
Force an API failure on the drill and take b05-failed.png
done_check: On <FRONTEND_URL>, walk the whole golden path in under 90 s with no sample badges
The mastery graph for fraction comparison changes after a correct answer and still shows the change after a reload
The browser check passes and its screenshots are reviewed
steps.fallback: Tap-to-answer buttons count as the answer if the mic or Saaras is flaky.
steps.notes: Freeze after this step. Remaining time goes to the demo run-through and a keep-warm ping on Render.

browser_tool: Playwright MCP (screenshots reviewed by the agent)
open_questions: Exact Saaras and Bulbul parameter names differ between doc snippets (language_code vs target_language_code, speaker names). Verify against sarvamai 0.1.43 in B03.
Total estimated time is about 30 minutes for one builder. If a second person is available, split frontend (B01, B04 UI) and backend (B02, B03 API).
tasteskill, ponytail and caveman are not installed. UI taste rules are in B01 notes, and prompts are kept short for token efficiency.
